sentences.text: The petitioner was tried for committing the offence under Section 7 punishable under Section 16(1)(a)(i) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954.

Vide judgment and order dated 6/8.9.2008, learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Gurgaon convicted him under Section 16(1)(a)(i) of the Act and sentenced him to undergo rigorous imprisonment for a period of six months and to pay a fine of Rs.1,000/-.
The amount of fine imposed was duly deposited by him.
Aggrieved of his conviction and sentence, the petitioner filed an appeal.

Vide judgment dated 19.5.2009, learned learned Additional Sessions Judge, Fast Track Court, Gurgaon found no reason to interfere in the conviction and sentence of the petitioner, and accordingly, dismissed the appeal.

entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge, Fast Track Court, Gurgaon
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 1 of 2
Still not satisfied, he filed the present revision which was admitted on 25.5.2009.
Subsequently vide order dated 8.6.2009, this Court was pleased to grant him bail.
On the last date of hearing, learned counsel for the petitioner apprised the Court that the petitioner had already passed away.
Learned State counsel, accordingly, prayed for a short adjournment for obtaining verification of the said fact.

sentences.text: Learned State counsel has produced the affidavit executed by Ajeet Singh, Assistance Commissioner of Police, Manesar wherein it stands mentioned that the petitioner had expired on 17.10.2011 while in Artimis Hospital, Gurgaon.
Accordingly, the factum of his death stands duly verified.
After being convicted and sentenced by the trial Court, the petitioner had deposited the amount of fine imposed upon him.
Under these circumstances, the present revision is only in respect of imprisonment imposed upon him.
As the petitioner has since expired, the present revision stands abated and is, accordingly, disposed of.
